observations.overview: Original site composition, station silhouette, curving track and trail retained; soft texture detail visible on grass and firs. Common framing still clips the far elevated terrain tip.
observations.top_down: Full square footprint and existing track/platform/trail layout retained; valid vertical view with no UI overlays.
observations.platform: Wood grain visible on nearest posts, barrel and sleepers; subtle mineral detail on plaster and paving; clock/text remain legible. Platform/track geometry and proportions retained.
observations.tracks: Mineral mottling visible on portal and retaining surfaces; rails and timber sleepers enter the same clear arch. No added rock intrusion at the portal.
observations.runtime_hello: Green Hello visible in actual PIE with pause/stop UI. Prior yellow directional-light priority warning is absent.

limitations: Low contrast in overview intentionally retained.
Common overview clips a far high corner, as in FirstDelivery.
Tiny facet UV seams and repeated patterns can remain; no claim of mathematically seamless generated textures.
